title: A convergence result for the master operator
summary: In this paper, we establish a convergence result for the fully fractional heat operator $\ma{s}$, also known as the master operator, stated as follows: \[\mbox{If\ }u_i\to u\ \mbox{in}\ C^{2,1}_{x,t,loc}(\R^n\times\R),\ \mbox{then}\ \ma{s} u_i\to \ma{s}u-b\ \mbox{a.e. in}\ \R^n\times\R,\] for some nonnegative constant $b$. This result addresses a fundamental question in the blow-up and rescaling analysis, which are essential for establishing a priori estimates for solutions of master equations.
